cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: How Much Do You Know?
cards.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle the missing-key questions. What has the manager actually said so far?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She thinks they're in the drain. I'm not getting between you two.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You won't have to. Just help me separate what she knows from what she's asking. Has anyone said they saw the keys?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only that someone saw you outside after closing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's useful. No need to speak for her; did they mention my hands, or only where I was standing? We'll keep it to what was actually seen.
